AcmeOps (customer): Hey team — since ~10:12 UTC we're getting 400s from the rerank endpoint (/v1/rerank). Calls used to work and suddenly started failing after we rolled a small client change. Sample body we sent (redacted keys):

AcmeOps (customer): ```json
{
  "query": {"text": "Which product is best?"},
  "candidates": []
}
```

Response: 400 Bad Request, body: `{ "error": "invalid_request", "message": "candidates must be a non-empty array" }`. No stacktrace in response.

Alex S (Support): Thanks for the report — sorry for the interruption. Can you confirm whether you previously sent `query` as a string and now it's an object? Also please paste the full response headers (we'll need x-request-id). I can escalate once I have the request id.

AcmeOps (customer): We recently switched to a small client wrapper that builds a richer object for query (so yes, now it's an object). Example curl (sanitized):

AcmeOps (customer): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query":{"text":"Which product is best?"},"candidates":[]}'
```

Alex S (Support): OK that explains the immediate error message about empty candidates, but if you also changed `query` shape it could trigger a separate validation error. We have two things to check: 1) our validator requires `candidates` to be non-empty; 2) `query` must be a string in the current API version (we recently tightened the schema).

Maria G (Engineering): Jumping in — confirmed: for the v1 rerank endpoint we expect this schema:

Maria G (Engineering): ```json
{
  "query": "<string>",
  "candidates": ["candidate text 1", "candidate text 2", ...]
}
```

Maria G (Engineering): We also accept the richer candidate objects if you pass `candidates` as an array of objects with `id` and `text` fields, e.g. `{ id: "c1", text: "..." }`. But `query` must be a top-level string for now — the object form you posted isn't supported in this API version and will produce a 400 with message about `query` type.

Maria G (Engineering): The specific error you saw (`candidates must be a non-empty array`) is triggered before type coercion, so an empty array will always 400. That's by design because empty inputs don't make sense for reranking.

AcmeOps (customer): Ah — we relied on the client to drop empty candidate sets earlier. We'll change that. Any chance of the server returning a clearer error code/message? The error we got was a bit terse and caused our retry logic to spam the endpoint.

Sam D (DevEx): Noted — we should have a better, machine-parsable error. I'll add a note to the developer docs suggesting checking for `candidates.length === 0` client-side before calling. Also will add a short troubleshooting snippet.

Sam D (DevEx): Suggested quick fix to unblock: ensure you send `query` as a string and `candidates` non-empty. Example that works: ```json
{
  "query": "Which product is best?",
  "candidates": ["Redwood Inference", "Other Inc"]
}
```

Maria G (Engineering): For reproducibility, here's a minimal failing request we ran locally (produces the same 400):

Maria G (Engineering): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":{},"candidates":[]}' -i
# Response snippet:
# HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
# {"error":"invalid_request","message":"candidates must be a non-empty array"}
```

Maria G (Engineering): Logs for the request_id you provided (x-request-id: req-9a7b) show validator failure in schema_check v2.0: `validation_error: candidates.length == 0` at /rerank/validate. No downstream stacktrace.

Alex S (Support): I've created an internal ticket for the docs/update + UX improvement to return distinct error codes for empty input vs type mismatch. JiraBot: RER-987 created (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RER-987). @Maria G can you assign owners?

JiraBot: Ticket RER-987 created by Alex S (Support) and assigned to Maria G (Engineering).

Maria G (Engineering): Assigned. We'll add a clearer error body: `{ "error": "invalid_input", "field": "candidates", "reason": "must be non-empty array" }` and create a migration note in the changelog for v1->v2 schema tightening. Low-risk change but will require a small client bump note.

AcmeOps (customer): Thanks — we'll patch our client to send `query` as a string and guard against empty arrays. Please ping when RER-987 has an ETA — the automation triggered by this error caused support noise.

Alex S (Support): ETA: planning to land the improved error format + docs by end of next week, will update this thread when it's merged. In the meantime, workaround: validate on client and avoid sending empty `candidates`. If you want, we can run a small compatibility check on some payload samples before your next release. :thumbsup:

AcmeOps (customer): Appreciate it. Confirmed workaround applied and 200s restored. Closing from our side but will follow up if anything else pops up.

Alex S (Support): Thanks — marking as resolved on our side for now. If you re-enable the richer `query` object schema later, we'll post migration guidance in the changelog and SDK release notes.
